description: Free. Young pump.fun coins (under three days old, from the trending lists) screened now on the preset chart traders use: 12-hour volume 2-5x the market cap, the top 10 holders 30% or less, under 15% of the supply bought in the first 10 seconds, a trade a second or more, no volume-bot shape. pass: all five; near: one or two missed, named. Refreshed every minute. For: coins that pass a screener, Axiom-style filters, volume and holders checks across coins. Often none pass; a screen, not a recommendation; then check_coin on a mint. Nov 28: give your own preset with min_/max_ arguments (top10, volmc, pace, bundle, age_h, mcap, volume_12h, holders, off_high, net_sol; shares as fractions, 0.2 is 20%); then only the rules you give are used (bots stays a rule unless bots is any), or set base to default to change only some of the default's rules.

base.description: none (default when a rule is given): only your rules; default: start from the default preset

bots.description: skip (default): leave out coins with a volume-bot shape; any: keep them

max_age_h.description: age in hours (candidates are under 72): at most

max_bundle.description: share of the supply the first 10 seconds' buyers took (0-1): at most

max_mcap.description: market cap in USD (candidates are $10,000 or more): at most

max_net_sol.description: net SOL flowing in on trending's list: at most

max_off_high.description: percent below the 12-hour high (0-100): at most

max_pace.description: trades a second over the last 5 minutes: at most

max_top10.description: share of the supply the top 10 holders hold (0-1): at most

max_volmc.description: 12-hour volume as a multiple of the market cap: at most

max_volume_12h.description: volume over the last 12 hours in USD: at most
